mapper.sql: b.id AS batch_id, b.exchange_batch_no AS batch_no, b.request_id, b.owner_company_id, dc.company_name AS owner_company_name, b.spec_code, b.display_name, b.service_type, b.duration_days, b.quantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exchange_detail ed WHERE ed.exchange_batch_id = b.id AND ed.status = 'COMPLETED') AS success_quantity, b.status, b.account_prefix, b.generation_source, b.created_at, b.completed_at, b.last_error_code, b.last_error_message

sql.if: AND ( b.request_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.exchange_batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.spec_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.generation_source LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.operator_user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM exchange_batch b LEFT JOIN dealer_company dc ON dc.company_id = b.owner_company_id
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC
